items.source: Decoder and HttpMessageReader implementations that buffer some or all of the input stream can be configured with a limit on the maximum number of bytes to buffer in memory. In some cases buffering occurs because input is aggregated and represented as a single object — for example, a controller method with @RequestBody byte[], x-www-form-urlencoded data, and so on.
